scenes.narration: If you already have a Python environment, you can install spaCR directly with pip. Python 3.12 is recommended. spaCR supports Python 3.9 through 3.14, except Python 3.14.1.
scenes.speech_text: If you already have a Python environment, you can install spacer directly with pip. Python 3.12 is recommended. spacer supports Python 3.9 through 3.14, except Python 3.14.1.

scenes.narration: First, upgrade pip in the current environment. If you are using Conda or a virtual environment, make sure it is active before running this command.
Install spaCR by running pip install spacr. This installs spaCR and makes its desktop launcher and command-line tools available in the current environment.
scenes.speech_text: Install spacer by running pip install spacer. This installs spacer and makes its desktop launcher and command-line tools available in the current environment.

scenes.narration: When installation finishes, enter spacr to open the desktop application. The first start can take longer while libraries initialize and model resources are prepared.
scenes.speech_text: When installation finishes, enter spacer to open the desktop application. The first start can take longer while libraries initialize and model resources are prepared.

scenes.narration: On a server or another headless system, use the same pip install spacr command. Then use spacr dash run dash dash list to see the workflows available from the command line.
scenes.speech_text: On a server or another headless system, use the same pip install spacer command. Then use spacer dash run dash dash list to see the workflows available from the command line.
